description: This bar chart illustrates accuracy scores for different evaluation tasks and model configurations. The horizontal axis represents the evaluation task, with categories labeled “MCQ Eval” and “Generation Eval”, arranged alphabetically. The vertical axis, labeled “Accuracy”, displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to 0.68, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. Within each task category, there are three bars representing different model configurations: “Base” (orange), “RMU with Enhanced GCG” (light green), and “RMU” (pale yellow). For “MCQ Eval”, the “Base” bar has a value of approximately 0.644, “RMU with Enhanced GCG” is at 0.539, and “RMU” is at 0.299. For “Generation Eval”, the “Base” bar is approximately 0.597, “RMU with Enhanced GCG” is at 0.263, and “RMU” is at 0.106. The bars are grouped by evaluation task, with each group containing one bar for each model configuration, and each bar is labeled with its corresponding value at the top. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
